language.name: English
help.title: 🎶 **DJ Snake commands**
help.cmd.play: `{prefix}play <link>`: play a YouTube or Spotify link (track, playlist or album)
help.cmd.seek: `{prefix}seek <position>`: jump to a position (seconds or mm:ss)
help.cmd.crossfade: `{prefix}crossfade on|off`: blend each track into the next
help.cmd.stop: `{prefix}stop`: stop, clear the queue and leave the voice channel
help.cmd.language: `{prefix}language [code|reset]`: language of the bot and the clip page (Manage Server)
